notes: Prompt delivery is ARGUMENT via -p (aliases --print / --prompt): that is the vendor's documented headless form, and in that mode the flag ignores stdin. An earlier draft of this adapter fed the prompt on stdin with no -p flag; one agy 1.5.9 build accepted that, but the behavior is not in the vendor's documented headless contract (stdin prompts are documented only via --print with --input-format), so the adapter follows the docs. --print-timeout's documented default is 0s (no limit), so the runner always sets it explicitly (job timeout + 20s). Modes: readonly maps to --mode plan; a fourth vendor mode, 'default' (pauses for review), is not on the common scale and is not emitted. auto requires a terminal sandbox (Windows 11 24H2 + updates, personal accounts) and falls back to 'default' behavior where unavailable - see the vendor modes doc. authCheck runs 'agy models': it is the documented model-list command, and secondary sources report it fails when signed out; that failure property is not stated in the vendor docs, so if your build prints the catalog while signed out, preflight cannot detect sign-out for this adapter. --dangerously-skip-permissions exists in agy and is NEVER emitted (the runner's denylist also blocks it).
